statement: The FOMC lowers its federal funds target range at its scheduled September 2026 meeting concluding 2026-09-16.
resolution: The FOMC statement published on federalreserve.gov on 2026-09-16 sets a target range below the range in effect on 2026-09-15. A hold or an increase resolves this false.
failure_condition: The target range in the September 2026 FOMC statement is unchanged from or higher than the range in effect on 2026-09-15.

statement: Brent crude records a daily spot price at or above 100.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one date between 2026-08-18 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: The EIA daily Europe Brent Spot Price FOB series contains at least one value of 100.00 or higher dated between 2026-08-18 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every EIA daily Brent spot value dated inside that window is below 100.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: CISA adds the exploited VMware vCenter flaw CVE-2026-59310 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-08-18 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry with cveID CVE-2026-59310 whose dateAdded value falls between 2026-08-18 and 2026-10-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-59310 is absent from the KEV catalog, or present with a dateAdded value outside that window.

statement: GE HealthCare Technologies files an SEC Form 8-K reporting a material cybersecurity incident under Item 1.05 between 2026-08-18 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: SEC EDGAR lists an 8-K filed by GE HealthCare Technologies Inc containing Item 1.05, with a filing date between 2026-08-18 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No 8-K containing Item 1.05 appears on the GE HealthCare EDGAR filing index with a filing date inside that window.

statement: No candidate exceeds 50 percent of valid votes in the Brazilian presidential first round held 2026-10-04, sending the race to the 2026-10-25 runoff.
resolution: Official TSE results for the 2026-10-04 first round show the leading presidential candidate at or below 50 percent of valid votes, and TSE confirms a second round.
failure_condition: TSE first-round results credit a candidate with more than 50 percent of valid votes, so no runoff is held.

statement: The Democratic Party wins at least 218 seats in the US House of Representatives in the 2026-11-03 midterm elections.
resolution: Associated Press race calls across all 435 districts contested on 2026-11-03 credit Democratic candidates with 218 or more seats.
failure_condition: The completed AP tally credits Democratic candidates with 217 or fewer House seats.

statement: The United States publicly announces the lifting or suspension of its naval blockade of Iranian ports between 2026-08-18 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: A White House, State Department, Defense Department or CENTCOM statement issued in that window announces the blockade lifted or suspended, and both Reuters and the Associated Press report it.
failure_condition: The naval blockade of Iranian ports remains in force through 2026-10-31 with no US government announcement lifting or suspending it.

statement: US forces conduct a military strike on Omani territory or Omani territorial waters between 2026-08-18 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: The US Defense Department or CENTCOM acknowledges a strike on Omani territory or territorial waters occurring in that window, and both Reuters and Agence France-Presse report it.
failure_condition: No US strike on Omani territory or Omani territorial waters occurs inside the window.

statement: USGS catalogs an earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 250 km of the epicenter of event us6000tkt2 between 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: A USGS ComCat query for magnitude 6.0 or greater events within 250 km of the us6000tkt2 epicenter, origin times between 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-30 UTC, returns at least one event.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog holds no magnitude 6.0 or greater event within 250 km of that epicenter inside the window.

statement: Cumulative confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak reach 15,000 or more on or before 2026-11-30.
resolution: A WHO situation report or ECDC communicable disease threats report dated on or before 2026-11-30 states cumulative confirmed cases of 15,000 or more for the DRC Bundibugyo outbreak.
failure_condition: The highest cumulative confirmed case count published for the DRC outbreak by 2026-11-30 remains below 15,000.
